coverage_explanation: Tests all four active-HIGH button-to-buzzer mappings and specified note frequencies, startup silence, release silence, sustained presses, direct changes between notes, and a repeated note. Checks pin modes and silence on nonselected buzzers. Simultaneous presses are excluded as required.
assumptions: Explicit circuit wiring overrides bench defaults: pins 2–5 are externally pulled down and pressed HIGH; buzzers are on pins 9–12.
The circuit lists 1kΩ pull-down resistors while the prose specifies 10kΩ. Both provide the same released LOW logic for this host behavioral test; no electrical resistor-value assertion is made.
No response latency is specified; observations allow at least 300 ms settling.
Frequency tolerance of 3 Hz accommodates ordinary tone timer quantization.
